mapper.select: SELECT id, train_no, train_type, direction, bureau, departure_time, arrival_time, duration_minutes, mileage FROM train WHERE train_no = #{trainNo}

SELECT t.train_no AS train_no, t.train_type AS train_type, s.station_name AS station_name, ts.station_order AS station_order, ts.arrival_time AS arrival_time, ts.departure_time AS departure_time, ts.day_offset AS day_offset, ts.mileage_from_start AS mileage_from_start FROM train_station ts JOIN train t ON t.id = ts.train_id JOIN station s ON s.id = ts.station_id WHERE t.status = 1 ORDER BY t.id, ts.station_order

SELECT t.train_no AS train_no, i.from_station_order AS from_station_order, i.price AS price FROM seat_inventory i JOIN train t ON t.id = i.train_id WHERE i.travel_date = #{travelDate} AND i.seat_type = #{seatType} ORDER BY t.id, i.from_station_order
